programs.description: Rajkumar's mother sets out to oppose his marriage after she finds out that he plans to marry the rival kingdom's princess.
Raj is hired as a bodyguard for Komal, and the two grow closer to each other over time. However, things get complicated when he comes across Nihal, the man who molested his sister.
Satpal Chauhan, a social worker from Haryana, works for women empowerment and also strives to create an alcohol-free society. However, while pursuing his goals, he faces several hardships.
When an ordinary man discovers crores in his account, he is thrown into a tangled mess of crime, impersonation and corrupt connections he never asked for.
Kalpana, a habitual liar, attempts to sabotage her sister's arranged marriage to a doctor, but complications arise when she develops feelings for him.
A father pretends to be a rich industrialist to improve his son's chances of marrying in to wealth. However, his plan backfires on him when his true identity is found out.
Shanti and Suraj lead a content life until he abandons her to marry Ruchi. Shanti and Ruchi both give birth to boys, who grow up and fight each other, unaware that they are half-brothers.
Shiva, a VAC College newcomer, opposes an aggressive student leader and violent thugs to secure his campus. Therefore, he acts.
A diligent and determined police officer is tasked with uncovering the truth behind a crooked warden involved in illicit weapon trafficking.
After a journalist helps to release him from prison, a man agrees to work as a hitman for her, leading him to entangle with a battle between two drug lords.
Falsely accused of murder, Raja becomes a target for Vijay, a police inspector and his lover's brother. In a bid to end his misery and catch the real culprit, Raja sets out on a mission.

When Shekhar falls for Roopa, he approaches her father with his parents. However, when his stepmother asks Roopa's father for dowry, he vows to marry his daughter elsewhere.
Three brothers, each raised in different religious households, reunite after many years in a chance encounter. They set out to take revenge on those responsible for separating them.
Yash, Taj and Gaurav fall madly in love with Isha, a beautiful and charming woman. However, Isha is friendly with all three men, unaware of their feelings towards her.
India 1974; Thriller; Dir. Ravi Tandon; Cast: Amitabh Bachchan, Parveen Babi. Ravi leads a good life with his mother & sister. When he learns that he is ill, he falsely takes the blame for a murder.
Three men are accused of stealing a crown and whilst on the run, they are transported to the 10th century. Amidst several adventures, they must try to bring the crown back to prove their innocence.

programs.showName: Deewaar: Let's Bring Our Heroes Home
programs.description: Haunted by the past, Vijay turns to crime, while Ravi, his younger brother, becomes an honest police officer. Fate pits them against each other when Ravi is sent to nab Vijay.
Fueled by a deep desire for revenge, two young boys mature into strong-minded adults and set out to secure the justice denied to their father years ago.
Two brothers who excel in boxing are separated in childhood and take different paths after their father, a police officer, is murdered by a gangster.
Pandit Girdhari Laal Sharma wants to get his daughter, Radha, married extravagantly but lacks the money for it. He then devises a plan to source the money, unaware of the consequences.
Radhe looks up to Kadak Singh, a local politician, but holds a grudge against his partner, Ram Tripathi. However, things reach a boiling point when Tripathi sets his sights on Radhe's wife, Lalli.

Anshul, an ordinary man, falls in love with Preeti, a politician's daughter. Things take a turn when Preeti's brothers disapprove of the relationship and commit a crime in order to end it.
After years of blindness caused by an accident, Naina gets a successful cornea transplant. However, she soon begins to see terrifying visions that prompt her to investigate the source of her sight.

Kunti abandons her baby in order to lead a lavish life and marries a rich man. Years later, she realises that her husband is indulging in an affair and is shocked to find out the truth about the girl.
Suspecting an extra-marital affair, Vijay, a professor, abandons his wife, Laxmi. However, years later, when he is hurtled back into Laxmi's life through her adopted daughter, things become clearer.

After the death of his mother, Raju's father re-marries, but his stepmother is only after the family's money. When Raju eventually marries, his wife tries to make him realise what kind of woman his stepmother is.

Amar sets out to avenge his father's death but gets beaten to the brink of death. He returns to carry on his vendetta, only to be confronted by Vicky, a criminal-turned-policeman and his close friend.
Shera hopes to marry Sapna, but is sent to prison for committing a crime. He is released after several months, only to be arrested again, unaware that he and Sapna are mere pawns in a dangerous game.
Sangeeta, a young woman, decides to sacrifice her dreams and work relentlessly to provide for her family after her father abandons them.
Raju and Madhu are forced apart by the latter's elder brothers, leading to increased distance between the two.
JD has several problems surrounding his marriage according to his horoscope. Unfortunately, his mother's constant nagging and friends' unwanted relationship advice only makes matters worse.

Three individuals from different backgrounds aspire to make it big in Bollywood but face difficulties as they carve their path.

Karan Saxena, a police officer, arrests Sapna Mathur, a woman accused of killing his fellow constable. Things take a turn when Karan falls in love with her and helps her escape her death sentence.
When Anoop ditches Mangala, she is forced to marry Anand, a blind singer. After seeing Anand's care, she falls for him, but things get complicated when Anoop re-enters the frame.
Madhumita and Vishwanathan fall in love with each other but his father disapproves of the relationship as he wants his twin sons to marry two identical twins.

The story revolves around two childhood friends, played by Himansh Kohli and Priya Banerjee, who go separate ways in pursuit of their respective dreams. When they return to their hometown and meet after a long separation, they understand that their relationship is more than just friendship.

Anuradha relocates to Mumbai where she meets Vivek, an aspiring politician, and marries him. Things take a turn when he is arrested for murder, and she has to take his place in the upcoming elections.

Dev and Priya fall in love despite being engaged to their respective partners and decide to reunite after six months to get married. However, destiny has other plans for them.

Salman and Rukhsar's love brings two warring families face to face, only for tradition, dowry demands and heartbreak to test their fragile bond.
